verdict.rationale: Agent-readable documentation is a fair question for a SaaS code-hosting product, so the axis applies. Probes returned HTTP 404 for both llms.txt and a markdown docs variant on Atlassian's support site, and no evidence shows agent-oriented docs. The official Atlassian MCP server belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
